operations.title: Triangle-wall quadratic non-descent is a canonical quotient line
operations.statement: For the frozen 26-dimensional source space, ker C has dimension 8, ker C intersect ker lambda has dimension 7, and lambda has rank one on ker C.
operations.scope: Strict ambient-thirteen finite residual packet over F_32003 only.

operations.title: Complete quadratic relation-space graph-image audit
operations.method: Compute all eight exact row relations of the 26 quadratic-coordinate rows and the rank of their images under the block-one graph functional.

operations.title: Benincasa identifies the canonical non-descent quotient line
operations.body: The complete quadratic relation space has dimension 8. The graph functional has rank one on it, leaving a 7-dimensional graph-zero subspace. Hence the invariant extra datum is the canonical quotient line ker(C)/(ker(C) intersect ker(lambda)), not the particular 13-probe witness. Your K5 adapter only needs to transport this quotient class invariantly; changing the witness by any of the seven graph-zero relations is harmless.

authority_basis.summary: Admitting the exact quotient-line theorem and communicating its adapter contract.
